FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
BRIEF ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE No. 19 OF 2026
Dated: 13-11-2026
Online Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the positions of Associate
Professor available in various Departments/ Institutes/ Centres of the University as indicated
below:-
1. Main Campus:
Arabic, Bio-Chemistry, Bio-Technology, Botany, Centre of Central Asian Studies, Chemistry,
Computer Science, Centre for Distance & Online Education, Economics, Education, Electronics &
Instrumentation Technology, English, Geography & Disaster Management, Hindi, History, Institute
of Home Science, Iqbal Institute of Culture & Philosophy, Shah-i-Hamdan Institute of Islamic
Studies, Kashmiri, Law, Library & Information Science, Linguistics, Management Studies,
Mathematics, Persian, Pharmaceutical Science, Political Science, Centre of Research for
Development, Shaikh-Ul-Aalam Centre for Multidisciplinary Studies, Sociology, Statistics, Tourism,
Hospitality and Leisure Studies, Urdu & Zoology.
IMPORTANT DATES:
I. Submission of Online Forms/Hard Copy from: 17th November, 2026
II. Last date for Submission of Online Forms 16th December, 2026
III. Last date for Submission of Hard copy 23rd December, 2026
The detailed Advertisement Notice/s containing essential qualifications, reservation of posts
and other terms & conditions will be available on the University website
www.kashmiruniversity.net under Jobs/Recruitment link from 17th November, 2026.
Note:- The availability of posts mentioned above are tentative and is subject to addition/
alteration/ deletion which, if any, shall be reflected in the detailed final Advertisement
Notice.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
(Recruitment)
No: F/Advt./KU-Asso-Prof/Rect/26
Dated: 13-11-2026
